idea-plugin.name: Chopper
idea-plugin.description: Toggles PHP parameter lists, argument lists, implements lists and closure use lists between one line and one item per line.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Split and join parameter lists, argument lists (including named and spread arguments), attribute arguments, implements/extends lists and closure use lists.
  • Adds a trailing comma on split when the project's PHP language level allows it; removes it on join.
